name: BridgeBio Pharma, Inc.
moat_justification: Attruby (acoramidis) is a differentiated, patent-protected near-complete TTR stabilizer taking first-line share in ATTR-CM at ~95% product gross margins, with an ex-U.S. royalty stream and a development engine that has put three more Phase-3-positive NDAs in FDA review — but the franchise is a single product against far larger Pfizer and Alnylam, and operating income has been negative every year on file (FY2025 -$523,411,000) with equity of -$2,086,610,000, so there is no ROIC history proving the moat in cash terms (the positive roic_proxy values in fundamentals.json are an artifact of the negative-equity denominator).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 9.1%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2018, 2019 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate
one_liner: Commercial-stage rare-disease biotech with a real, fast-growing Attruby franchise and moat 5/10, but owner's earnings are negative on every base (TTM -$2.98/sh, 0/5 positive years) and debt, royalty and preferred claims keep stacking ahead of the common — no positive price clears the 15% hurdle until it prints a positive-OE year.
moat_for: Near-complete (>=90%) TTR stabilization — differentiation vs tafamidis, first-line share still climbing, supportive real-world data
Product gross margin 95.3% (Q2 2026); total gross margin 95.82% FY2025 / 98.25% FY2024 — real product-level pricing power
Ex-U.S. Beyonttra royalty stream at zero commercial cost
Repeatable rare-disease platform: BBP-418, encaleret and infigratinib all in FDA review simultaneously
moat_against: Single-product concentration — Attruby is essentially all product revenue
Pfizer Vyndaqel/Vyndamax (entrenched incumbent) and Alnylam Amvuttra — larger, better-capitalized competitors
No positive operating income or meaningful ROIC in any filed year; equity -$2,086,610,000
Claim stack ahead of common keeps growing: convertibles, deferred royalty obligations, 7% preferred (Jul 2026); share count +9.1%/yr
